violations.description: HANDWASHING LAVATORIES AND SUPPLIES (3 pts): Soap and a hand drying method was noted not provided at the hand washing lavatories in the kitchen.

INSECT RODENT ANIMAL CONTROL (3 pts): The building containing the food service was noted with a structure which would allow the entrance of insects and/ or rodents. Rear door bottom sweep missing creating a gap beneith the door.

THAWING POTENTIALLY HAZARDOUS FOOD (2 pts): Potentially hazardous foods noted not being thawed using approved methods. Observed shrimp being thawed in the wash bay of a 3 comp sink without an air gap.

CROSS CONTAMINATION (5 pts): Raw meat noted being stored above food not to be further cooked. Observed steak stored above sliced peppers in drawer styler cooler beneith flattop grill. Observed sliced bacon stored above shrimp on ice and rice in walk in cooler.
SANITIZATION OF EQUIP. AND UTENSILS (4 pts): An inadequate amount of chlorine sanitizer was noted in the final rinse of the kitchen dish machine.
DISHWASHING FACILITIES (2 pts): The three compartment sink was noted not being properly operated.
